subjects.label: cargo-registry-src
subjects.provenance: The cargo registry source cache, populated by cargo fetch over the lockfiles this machine has built. Shape depends on which crates those lockfiles pull, so it is not a recipe another machine can follow.

subjects.label: rustup-toolchains
subjects.provenance: The rustup toolchain store for this machine's installed toolchains. Shape depends on which toolchains and targets are installed, so it is not a recipe another machine can follow to the same tree.

subjects.label: usr-share
subjects.provenance: The system prefix as macOS ships it, plus whatever this host's package installs have added. Not reconstructible: it is a function of the OS build and the local install history.
